title: Brand image and camera display
summary: This topic combines favorable comments about brand image and camera clarity with a few unclear camera display mentions and one complaint about inaccurate camera proximity showing.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the brand image, safety impression, service support, and the clear backup camera image.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says the camera image appears slightly inaccurate and makes obstacles seem nearer while reducing visibility of parking blocks in the front view.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention a car image, image performance, or a rear display showing black, but the excerpts are too limited to confirm sentiment.

limitations: This cluster mixes at least two subjects: brand image and camera or display imagery.
Several excerpts are very short, which limits confident interpretation of the underlying issue or sentiment.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G60 feedback on this topic.
